text: The absence of pain despite significant cholestasis and weight loss in a smoker and heavy drinker raises concern for pancreatic cancer or cholangiocarcinoma. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_CTA

text: The normal MRCP rules out extrahepatic biliary obstruction, so the issue must be intrahepatic. Given your heavy alcohol use and cholestatic labs, I suspect alcoholic hepatitis or early cirrhosis. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Biopsy
